en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah
<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who shaves off his head in Makkah. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should return the hair to Mina’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtariy who has said the following: “About a man who shaves in Makkah abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
has said, ‘He must return (take) his hairs to Mina’.’”
